rule: Edited-model accuracy at a stated edit norm follows the base plus the flat random-edit curve: on hard328 with the cue (T 1.0, one sample, seed 3000000) the base scores 164 and random rank-8 edits at sizes -1 to 3 (incl. two draws at 1.5x) score 152-167, mean about 160 with sd about 4, so any norm-matched 1.5x edit whose content I may not use gets about 160 with an interval of single-sample noise plus allowance for subspace structure (m smaller = more concentrated edit = slightly wider low tail); vote-over-k accuracy of the untrained cued base follows a log-k curve fitted to its own board points on the 328 (159.5 at 1, 188.5 at 4, 197 at 6, which fit vote(k)=159.5+20.9 ln k exactly) and checked on the stored explore-half rows (vote over 4 of samples 0-3 = 94 of 164, x2 = 188), with interval width from tie-breaking noise measured on those rows (plus or minus 5 on the half) and per-sample noise.

predictors: edit norm: matched to the 1.5x edit (number), m = 64 subspace dimension
forecasts.derivation: A norm-matched 1.5x edit sits in the flat region of the random-edit curve, so it gets the random-edit mean of about 160, with single-sample spread.
